deployment_window_observed.rule: daily rebuild and Docker cleanup require coordinator window; code work and isolated project checks may proceed

mandatory_global_preconditions: Coordinator grants a cleanup window with owner=Trip/state=granted; null/not_granted means do nothing.
Daily final deployment/readback and affected validation complete and evidence retained.
Recollect Docker metadata/references; abort if any ID, ownership, mount, protected backup or cross-project reference changed.
Use exact separately approved full container/network IDs and exact named volume identities, never glob/prefix-based deletion, global prune, down -v or implicit --volumes.
No filesystem backup/recovery/maintenance material deletion; unknown resources and shared cache remain retained.

image_review_boundary: Current Docker image Id/Descriptor can be an OCI index digest, not config. Final protected backup byte identity and amd64 index->manifest->config/layers verified/reused explicitly. RootFS DiffIDs are uncompressed and are not OCI compressed blob digests. Older or unreferenced images remain retained/review because disposal/rollback/index closure proof is incomplete; no shared blob pruning.
security_policy_deviation: Earlier premature ephemeral cleanup remains recorded separately; lack of captured old IDs is not repaired by guessing and does not justify new deletion.
state_is_not_authority: Running/stopped/exited/created and <none> tags are descriptive only, never sole deletion reasons.
post_cleanup_requirements: Only if a future cleanup is separately authorized/executed: record exact successes/failures, recollect post inventory, confirm retained daily/final/recovery metadata and business readback, preserve original running preferences.
